title: Missing professional seal
evidence: No CIAPR seal/signature/date in any title block.
explanation: Construction documents in Puerto Rico must bear the seal and signature of a professional licensed by the Colegio de Ingenieros y Agrimensores de Puerto Rico (CIAPR).
correction: Apply a CIAPR-licensed seal, signature, and date to every sheet.

title: Architectural set incomplete
evidence: Index lists sheets; full architectural set not submitted.
explanation: A complete architectural set is required to evaluate egress, separations, and life-safety provisions.
correction: Submit the complete architectural set matching the index.

title: Drawing index mismatch
evidence: Index lists sheets not present in the package.
explanation: The sheet index should match the sheets submitted exactly to prevent documentation gaps.
correction: Reconcile the index with the submitted sheets.

title: EERO not verifiable
evidence: Bedroom 2 = Fixed Glass 36x72; no net-clear-opening tabulated.
explanation: Each sleeping room needs an operable emergency escape opening >= 5.7 sf, sill <= 44 in.
correction: Add net-clear-opening + sill columns; provide a compliant operable EERO per bedroom.

title: Garage/dwelling separation incomplete
evidence: Habitable room above garage; no 5/8" Type X ceiling.
explanation: Habitable space over a garage requires a 5/8 in. Type X ceiling separation and protected penetrations.
correction: Call out 5/8" Type X garage ceiling + protected penetrations.

title: Dwelling unit count ambiguous
evidence: Second kitchen + separable lower level; unit count unstated.
explanation: Unit count determines the applicable code path (PRRC vs. PRBC) and separation requirements.
correction: State unit count; if two units, show separation + independent egress.

title: Windborne-debris protection not shown
evidence: Large fixed glazing, no shutters; San Juan is in the debris region.
explanation: Glazed openings in the windborne-debris region require impact-resistant glazing or tested opening protection.
correction: Add an opening-protection schedule with per-opening design pressures.

title: Seismic design category not stated
evidence: Notes say 'Seismic Zone C'; no site Ss/S1 or SDC.
explanation: The lateral system and any concrete detailing must be designed to the site SDC.
correction: Provide Ss/S1, derive SDC, show lateral + ACI 318 Ch.18 detailing.

title: Wind speed not PR basis
evidence: Notes say 76/90 mph; PR is ~145-170 mph ultimate.
explanation: Ultimate design wind speed must conform to the PR wind map (typically 145-170 mph).
correction: Re-state design wind speed from the PR map / ASCE 7 Hazard Tool.

title: Corrosion-resistant connectors missing
explanation: Puerto Rico building code amendments require corrosion-resistant hardware for exposed members.
correction: Upgrade exposed connectors/anchors to the required corrosion class.

title: Energy compliance not Zone 1A
explanation: Energy compliance modeling must be for Climate Zone 1A (hot-humid) using SHGC targets.
correction: Re-run energy for Zone 1A; remove snow/cold-climate items.

title: Guardrail design missing
explanation: Guards are required where the drop exceeds 30 in.; minimum height is 36 in.
correction: Add a guard detail: 36" min, infill <4" sphere, 50 plf/200 lb loads.

title: Illustrative views not labeled
evidence: Diagrammatic views not labeled 'not for construction'.
explanation: Diagrammatic structural drawings must be clearly distinguished from construction details.

title: Stair width below minimum
explanation: Minimum stair width under the International Residential Code is 36 inches.
correction: Correct note to 36" minimum clear width.

title: Window schedule numbering gap
explanation: Numbering gaps in window schedule tags may indicate missing structural drawing components.
correction: Confirm no window dropped; renumber or note the gap.

title: No net-clear-opening column
explanation: A net-clear-opening column is required in window schedules to verify compliance of EEROs.
correction: Add a net-clear-opening column to the window schedule.

title: Flood zone determination absent
evidence: Coastal parcel; no FEMA zone or BFE shown.
explanation: Coastal parcels require flood design considerations to resist waves and hydrodynamic forces.
correction: Add flood determination; if SFHA show BFE + ASCE 24.
